tagline: Simple, useful apps for your iPhone

apps.name: PicSnip
apps.description: PicSnip helps you clean up and organize your photo library, right on your iPhone.

health.data_types: YOUR LIST, e.g. step count, heart rate, sleep analysis (read from Apple Health with your permission)
health.purposes: YOUR PURPOSES, e.g. to show you trends and insights inside the app
health.third_parties: None. We do not share consumer health data with third parties.

photos_description: PicSnip asks for access to your photo library so you can review, organize, and clean up your photos. You choose which photos the app can access (including limiting access to selected photos) and can change this at any time in Settings > Privacy & Security > Photos. Your photos are processed on your device and are not uploaded to our servers.
